page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-88-standardlssd is a storage-optimized instance tailored for I/O-intensive and data-heavy applications. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with x86_64 architecture running at 2.7 GHz, it features 44 physical cores and 88 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. The processor includes 105 MB of L3 cache alongside advanced vector and matrix instruction support, including AVX-512, AMX Tile, and AMX INT8. Memory capacity is substantial at 704 GB of RAM, equating to an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio (8.0 GB per vCPU). The system has no GPUs attached and integrates 19,326 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 6 drives.

Benchmark results demonstrate upper-quartile parallel processing and throughput capabilities. In multi-core testing, the instance achieved a stress-ng score of 72,940.45, a PassMark CPU score of 72,197.10, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17,992.00, placing it in the top 25% of evaluated systems. High-throughput data operations are further reflected in a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 436.9 GB/sec and Redis SET throughput exceeding 84 million operations per second. Hardware instruction support aids specialized operations, evidenced by strong extended instruction scores and image processing within the top 10% tier. Conversely, single-core benchmarks hover within average percentiles, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1701.00 and a stress-ng single-core rating of 1620.59.

Resource scaling provides high density for workloads constrained by memory capacity and disk access speeds. With 19,326 GB of directly attached NVMe storage coupled with 704 GB of RAM, the instance minimizes reliance on external storage networks and avoids network-bound I/O bottlenecks. However, workloads requiring high single-thread clock rates or dedicated GPU hardware will encounter limitations on this architecture.

Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-88-standardlssd is well suited for high-throughput relational databases, in-memory caching systems, distributed data processing, large-scale ETL pipelines, and high-concurrency static web serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-88-standardlssd is a storage-optimized instance equipped with 88 dedicated vCPUs across 44 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8481C processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with AMX and AVX-512 vector support, it supplies 704 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per core) and incorporates 19,326 GB of local NVMe SSD storage spanning 6 drives. The instance contains no discrete GPUs. In benchmark evaluations, multi-threaded CPU execution and data processing show upper-tier performance, highlighted by over 84 million Redis SET operations per second, a multi-core Geekbench score of 17,992, and strong memory read bandwidth of 217.29 GB/sec on large uncached blocks. Single-threaded benchmarks remain in the middle percentile range. The high local SSD storage and dense memory configuration make this server suitable for large databases, high-capacity caching layers, analytics engines, and intensive multi-threaded workloads.
